text:
Predicates:
Likes(x, y) ::: x likes y.
Wants(x, y) ::: x wants to y.
HasAccess(x, y) ::: x has access to y.
CanCompose(x) ::: x can compose.
WillCompose(x) ::: x will compose.
Premises:
Likes(george, music) → Wants(george, compose) ::: If George likes music, he wants to compose.
∀x (HasAccess(george, x) → CanCompose(george)) ::: If George has access to a program, he can compose.
∀x (CanCompose(x) ∧ Wants(x, compose) → WillCompose(x)) ::: If George can compose and wants to compose, he will compose.
Conclusion:
(Likes(george, music) ∧ HasAccess(george, program)) → WillCompose(george) ::: If George likes music and has access to a program, he will compose.
